item.title: Council leaders welcome Minister’s backing for Swindon to Oxford rail link
item.description: Council leaders in Swindon and Oxfordshire have welcomed confirmation from Rail Minister Peter Hendy that the Government supports progressing a two-hourly direct rail service between Swindon and Oxford. item.title: Appeal for dash cam footage after indecent assault in Swindon
item.description: Police are appealing for witnesses and dash cam footage following a serious incident involving a teenage girl in Swindon. Wiltshire Police said the incident happened between approximately 12.45pm and 12.55pm on Thursday 12 February on Queens Drive. item.title: First brush-tailed bettong joey hand-reared at Longleat
item.description: A tiny brush-tailed bettong joey is being hand-reared by keepers at Longleat in a first for the Wiltshire estate. The female joey, who has not yet been named, is thought to be around 90–100 days old and weighs just 135 grams. item.title: Two wholesale cocaine suppliers jailed following Swindon drugs investigation
item.description: Two men who supplied cocaine wholesale to local dealers across Swindon have been jailed following a major police investigation. item.title: Section 35 dispersal order enacted in Swindon town centre
item.description: Wiltshire Police have implemented a Section 35 dispersal order in Swindon town centre following significant antisocial behaviour on the evening of 18 February.
